summary: Fixed the operator-reported bug where a diary entry shows Time-verified and then reverts to Time-verifying. Grounding found the cause: JournalCard and JournalDetail computed the verification badge ONLY from the transient anchor queue, which is device-local IndexedDB. When that queue does not have the entry's row — a re-unlock, a fresh browser session, a restore on a new device — the badge fell back to 'Time-verifying'. But the confirmed OpenTimestamps anchor is durably attached to the attestation itself (the WalletProvider effect attaches it and it rides the encrypted wallet backup). Both views now read attestation.anchor first and only fall back to the queue for entries not yet confirmed, so once an entry is verified the badge is sticky. Commit b2260f9.

why.text: Operator: a file shows verified, then comes back not verified; wants verified to stay persisted, with the math re-checkable on demand but no needless re-trying. Investigation confirmed nothing was actually re-verifying — the anchor worker already skips confirmed rows — it was purely a display reading the wrong source. The fix honours the durable verified state already persisted on the attestation.

files_changed: src/features/journal/JournalCard.tsx (modify), src/features/journal/JournalDetail.tsx (modify) — one commit plus comms
outcome.notes: [P-001] JournalCard + JournalDetail read attestation.anchor before the queue (commit b2260f9). [P-002] all four gates green. Display-only fix; no worker or data-model change — the verified state was always persisted, the views were not reading it. [FEEDBACK->Foreman]: no notes — the operator's bug report described the desired fix precisely and grounding confirmed it.

uncertainty: Build-verified. The real proof is the operator reloading the live deploy and confirming a previously-verified entry now stays verified. The fix is small and the cause well understood, so confidence is high.
next: Operator confirms verified badges stay sticky on the live deploy after a reload / re-unlock. Phase 5b (organizations + membership) remains the next Layer 3 build.
